search_assistants: search for assistants by graph_id, name, metadata with pagination limit and offset
get_assistant: get an assistant by its ID from the LangGraph Platform-compatible assistants API
get_assistant_graph: get the graph structure for a given assistant ID
get_assistant_schemas: get JSON input, output, state, and config schemas for an assistant
list_assistants: list all registered assistants including the default lead_agent and custom agents
